Each PNG is copied without changes from its original archive. All are 256×256.
CSS displays these images at icon size and supplies a surrounding frame.
Art assignment is descriptive UI decoration, not a change to spell effects or
an assertion about the original game's artwork. The source filename
"lighting-sky-3.png" intentionally retains the author's spelling.
